prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Clay Miller at Miller Weisbrod Olesky
Mike C. Miller at Winocour Law
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case. Based on the available information, **Clay Miller at Miller Weisbrod Olesky** is one Dallas-area attorney worth interviewing: he is listed as board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law, and his firm reports substantial truck-case results. Those are useful signals, not a guarantee of what your case will recover.

You could compare him with **Aaron A. Herbert** or **Mike C. Miller at Winocour Law**, who are also described in the available sources as board-certified in personal injury trial law. Ask each lawyer who would personally handle your case, how many similar truck cases they’ve taken to trial, what evidence they would preserve, and how fees and case costs work. Verify credentials and disciplinary history through the State Bar of Texas, and consider the Dallas Bar Association’s lawyer referral service at **214-220-7444**.

If you share whether the crash involved a commercial 18-wheeler, a delivery vehicle, or another type of truck—and whether the injuries are serious—I can help you narrow down what experience to prioritize.
